name: draw_text
evidence: drawtext builds the text in it, up to 1000 letters and an end mark

name: draw_number
evidence: drawtext formats one number or string in it before it adds it to the text. The 1024 bytes run to the next object

name: glext
evidence: flags of the OpenGL extensions that the client checks at start. The Linux client names the symbol glext, 0x44 bytes. Entry 8 is the two sided stencil and entry 9 the separate stencil operation

name: programs
evidence: setupprogramobjects and compileprogramobject: one record of 0x50 bytes for each of the 32 program slots. Ten of them hold a compiled program

name: shader_log
evidence: compileprogramobject adds the info logs to it. setupprogramobjects writes it to shaderoutput.txt

name: info_log
evidence: compileprogramobject reads the info log of an object into it

name: render_width
evidence: setupprogramobjects gives the shaders the size of one pixel: 1 over this width

name: render_height
evidence: setupprogramobjects gives the shaders the size of one pixel: 1 over this height

name: open_file
evidence: the handle of the open text or image file: shaderoutput.txt, a screenshot and the settings file

name: light_position
evidence: the direction of the light, in world space. The model, landscape, sector and sky passes pass it to OpenGL and to the shaders

name: world_position
evidence: renderframeatmosphere and render_sectorlist pass it to the shaders as the world position

name: viewport_width
evidence: renderframeatmosphere sets the viewport from it

name: viewport_height
evidence: renderframeatmosphere sets the viewport from it

name: track_vbo
evidence: rendertrackmodel: the index into vbo of the buffer of the track

name: track_vertex_floats
evidence: rendertrackmodel: the floats of one vertex of the track buffer

name: track_vertex_count
evidence: rendertrackmodel: the vertices of the track buffer

name: frustum_planes
evidence: boxinsidefrustum writes the five plane normals into it each time it runs

name: shadow_corners
evidence: rendermodelshadow: the three pushed corners and the three corners of the triangle in work

name: shadow_count
evidence: rendermodelshadow: the points in the list of the shadow

name: shadow_list
evidence: rendermodelshadow: the triangles of the shadow volume, as points. The next object starts 0x2fffc bytes after it

name: chat_head
evidence: frame_drawmessages walks the ring of messages from this index back. createmessage moves it

name: sprite_models
evidence: createsprite_model and sprite_model_simulation: the flying pieces. A record has 0x68 bytes

name: shell_verts
evidence: the corners of the landed shell casings. renderspritemodels draws them

name: debris_verts
evidence: the corners of the landed pieces of debris. renderspritemodels draws them

name: score_count
evidence: drawplayerinfo: the number of players in the column that it builds

name: score_entries
evidence: drawplayerinfo: the player and the worth of each player of the column, before the sort

name: display_text
evidence: drawdisplay builds a stock price or a chat line in it before drawtext

name: light_ambient
evidence: renderframe sets it as the ambient color of the light 0 and the interior window pass draws with it

name: interior_corners
evidence: render_sector_interior_shadow2: the three corners of a triangle and the same corners pushed away from the light

name: sector_part_count
evidence: clearsectorlist: the number of runs of triangles for each material

name: sector_draw_counts
evidence: clearsectorlist: the index count of each run, 0x4000 runs for each material

name: sector_draw_offsets
evidence: clearsectorlist: the place of the indices of each run, 0x4000 runs for each material

name: sector_count
evidence: clearsectorlist: the number of sectors with an interior to draw

name: sector_list
evidence: clearsectorlist: the sectors with an interior, from the nearest

name: sector_entries
evidence: clearsectorlist: the sectors with an interior and their distance, before the sort

name: interior_model_count
evidence: clearsectorlist clears it. The interior model builder adds 1 for each model

name: sector_vertices
evidence: render_sectorlist: the vertices of the sectors, 64 bytes each

name: sector_indices
evidence: clearsectorlist: the triangle indices of the sectors, 12 bytes for each triangle

name: sector_vbo
evidence: render_sectorlist: the number of the buffer of the sector vertices

name: sprites
evidence: spritesimulation and rendersprites: particles and glass with a stride of 0x94

name: sprite_decals
evidence: rendersprites draws the landed particles as textured quads

name: glass_vertices
evidence: rendersprites draws the landed glass with a normal at each vertex

name: tiremarks
evidence: tiremark_simulation writes four position and opacity pairs in each strip

name: selected_item
evidence: the free item nearest to the viewed human within the 1.5 unit reach segment

name: sector_shadow_corners
evidence: Six corners of the current sector shadow volume

name: sector_shadow_count
evidence: Number of vertices in the sector shadow list

name: sector_shadow_vertices
evidence: Sector shadow side faces and caps

name: sector_shadow_buffer_ready
evidence: The shadow buffer has its three megabyte allocation

name: sector_shadow_vbo
evidence: Index of the sector shadow vertex buffer

name: frame_model_count
evidence: Number of models in the frame list

name: frame_model_order
evidence: Sorted frame model indices

name: frame_models
evidence: Frame model transforms and draw parameters with a stride of 100

name: video_modes
evidence: SDL display modes stored as width height and pixel depth

name: video_mode_count
evidence: Number of stored SDL display modes

name: screenshot_pixels
evidence: RGBA screenshot pixels with a limit of 1280 by 960

name: blur_params_near
evidence: The eight weights of the depth blur. The first four go to the shader as the near parameters and the last four as the far parameters (blur_params_far)

name: viewport_x
evidence: renderframe clears the left edge of the frame viewport

name: viewport_y
evidence: renderframe clears the bottom edge of the frame viewport

name: light_diffuse
evidence: getsuncolors writes the diffuse color of light 0. renderframe colors the sun with it

name: sky_color
evidence: getskycolor writes the sky color of the frame

name: view_near
evidence: renderframe sets the near plane of the perspective view to 0.0625

name: view_far
evidence: renderframe sets the far plane of the perspective view to 16384

name: view_fov
evidence: renderframe copies view_zoom to the angle of the perspective view

name: view_side_right
evidence: renderframe turns the right edge direction of the view cone with the camera

name: view_side_left
evidence: renderframe turns the left edge direction of the view cone with the camera

name: window_quad_count
evidence: buildframelist adds one for each car window. renderframe sorts the windows by distance

name: window_quads
evidence: buildframelist writes four corners a normal a distance and a facing flag with a stride of 0x44

name: framebuffers
evidence: mainmenu creates two framebuffers with their depth renderbuffers

name: framebuffer_index
evidence: mainmenu writes 0. renderframe and setupframetextures bind this framebuffer
